text:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran the audit-event coverage scan across services. Found gaps that could impact customer-facing validation and compliance checks: api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. Can we triage & assign owners? :eyes:
aj: Thanks — can you paste the specific missing event types and whether they affect schema/PII fields?
maria: Sure, short list: api-gateway: route.create/route.delete missing actor_id and request_id; auth: token.revoke not emitted on SSO logout; console: settings.update missing previous_value/author metadata; billing: invoice.download not logged (customer dispute risk); runtime: model.fallback and model.quantize events missing request_path and model_version. Some also don't adhere to the new audit_event_v2 schema.
kevin: paste of failing example + schema mismatch:
```json
{
  "event_type": "route.create",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T12:00:00Z",
  "actor": "user:123",
  "resource": {"type":"route","id":"r-1"}
}
```
kevin: event above is missing request_id and uses "actor" freeform instead of "actor_id" (audit_event_v2 requires actor_id, request_id, tenant_id when applicable).
sre-bot: Alert: compliance-checker flagged 12 events from api-gateway in last 30d that do not match audit_event_v2. See /alerts/AC-2005.
sara: Billing gap is high risk — invoice.download is part of PCI-adjacent flows for some customers. We need customer-facing validation tests and a quick mitigation (log at proxy) while we fix service.
aj: Proposed triage plan: 1) create a backlog ticket per service with failing signatures; 2) assign owner + add QA prompt set for customer-facing events; 3) short-term proxy/logging shim for billing/auth if fix will take >3d; 4) schedule schema migration window for audit_event_v2 changes.
maria: owners suggestion: aj -> api-gateway, kevin -> auth, sara -> billing, devon -> runtime, maria -> console. Prios: billing/auth > runtime > gateway > console.
devon: For runtime model events, we can add a minimal emitter in front of the model pool (inference-proxy) — low-risk, quick patch. I can spin a PR for that today. :thumbsup:
kevin: For auth token.revoke, problem is SSO provider callback flow bypasses our logout handler; suggested quick fix: hook callback to emit token.revoke and then emit standardized audit_event_v2. I'll start a branch.
aj: Schema note — audit_event_v2 example snippet for teams (copy into PR templates):
```json
{
  "event_type": "<service>.<action>",
  "timestamp": "RFC3339",
  "actor_id": "user_...",
  "request_id": "req-...",
  "tenant_id": "org_...",
  "resource": {"type":"<type>","id":"<id>"},
  "meta": {"ip":"","user_agent":""}
}
```
aj: Also add unit tests that validate presence of actor_id/request_id and that no PII is in freeform fields.
maria: Action items (owners to ack here):
 - aj: create gateway ticket + quick scan for route events; due EOD tomorrow.
 - kevin: auth PR for token.revoke emitter + tests; due in 48h.
 - sara: billing proxy plan + customer validation tests; due 72h.
 - devon: runtime emitter PR; due 48h.
 - maria: console schema patch + roll-forward plan; due 5d.
Please add backlog links and tag me when created.
sre-bot: Created epic audit-events/2005 with placeholders, assigned devon, kevin, aj, sara, maria. Epic link: https://redwood.internal/epic/audit-events-2005
sara: Added owner + quick workaround in epic, will post QA checklist for customer validation tomorrow.
kevin: acked, will post branch link when ready.
aj: acked, starting ticket now.
maria: thanks — let's re-sync in 48h standup, leave any blockers here. :white_check_mark:
